subject: the plug-in menu an insert_plugin refusal leaves on screen, before and after the #1016 change
question: After insert_plugin presses a slot and then refuses, is a Logic window at or above the pop-up menu level still on screen, and does the response say what became of it?

reverify.expected: every candidate refusal is leaf_not_offered_by_this_strip with plugin_popup_menu_state dismissed and no Logic window at or above the pop-up menu level afterwards; at least one control refusal leaves such a window open; slot 0 is read free after every sample
reverify.cost: needs LPM_EVIDENCE_ROOT exported as an absolute path outside the repository, a running Logic with a project whose mixer shows a free insert slot 0, and two release binaries (the change and its parent); inserts nothing and switches no language; about two minutes

method: The probe read the product's logic://mixer for strips with a free insert slot 0 and took the first, track 1 of the lpm-locale-campaign fixture in Korean. It located the Mixer on the live tree by the mixerNamedElement label family (the 1317-wide AXLayoutArea; the same label also names a 235-wide one), ran one unmeasured control refusal so the strip selection that recolours it happened before any capture, started a screen recording, and then ran six samples alternating control then candidate on that track. Each started its binary's MCP server and asked logic_mixer.insert_plugin for Gain at slot 0 with configuration 'lpm-1016-no-such-layout', which no strip offers, so the slot is pressed, the plug-in menu opens, the Gain submenu is walked and the request is refused. Immediately after the response the probe listed Logic-owned on-screen windows at or above CGWindowLevelForKey(kCGPopUpMenuWindowLevelKey); that list is menus_open_after_response, and a list the window server did not return would have been recorded as unknown and failed the sample. Anything found was then closed with System Events Escapes and listed again, the Mixer band was captured before and after each sample and compared, and the mixer was read back to confirm slot 0 was still free. The candidate is a release build of fa641b5b (sha256 216304b8...); the probe ran at 0b945912, which differs from fa641b5b only in this probe script. The control is a release build of ff00ff9a, the parent of the #1016 change (sha256 0fb1566c...). The evidence document is is_clean: two of two checks passed, twelve captures all settled, six visual comparisons passed, one recording, no failed restoration. Nothing was changed by hand.
conclusion: On this host the parent's refusal left one Logic window at layer 101 (230 by 527 points) open after all three of its refusals, and its response said nothing about it. The candidate's three refusals each reported plugin_popup_menu_state dismissed, and the probe read no Logic window at or above the pop-up menu level after any of them. The same reading that saw the control's menu saw none after the candidate, so the clean readings are not a blind instrument; no reading in the run came back unknown. The Mixer band was unchanged across every sample and slot 0 was read free after each, so neither binary inserted anything.
limits: Only the leaf_not_offered_by_this_strip refusal was driven here. root_menu_not_found goes through the same cleanup call; the #993 locale sweep at an earlier head read plugin_popup_menu_state dismissed and no open menu after it in zh_TW, but that run's control never refused, so it has no same-run control for that branch.

The product counts windows at exactly the pop-up menu level (101). The layer-102 window recorded in #1016's report did not appear in this run, so whether the candidate leaves one open, or reports no_popup_observed over one, was not measured.

Every window-list read in this run came back, so the paths for an unreadable list were not reached live: the AX cancel that now runs when the first count is unreadable, window_count_unavailable and could_not_be_dismissed are driven only by unit tests with a fixture window list.

The popup was not photographed on its own: screencapture -l with its window number returned a 3840 by 2100 image while the window server listed it at 230 by 527 points, so no region inside it could be placed. The screen recording shows it; the window-server list is the measurement.

One Logic installation, one project, Korean only; the refusal and the cleanup read no localized label, which is why one language was driven. The probe's Mixer lookup does read the localized label family.

canon_not_applicable.reason: The record measures window-server behaviour (whether a Logic window at the pop-up menu level remains after a refusal) and the product's own response fields; it quotes no string Logic ships.
